title: Boom Esports wins PKL Fall 2026, captures back-to-back titles
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Boom Esports secured the Honor of Kings Philippine Kings League (PKL) Fall 2026 Championship after overpowering JGame Esports, 4-1, in the Grand Finals on November 8 at Samsung…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Boom Esports secured the Honor of Kings Philippine Kings League (PKL) Fall 2026 Championship after overpowering JGame Esports, 4-1, in the Grand Finals on November 8 at Samsung Hall, SM Aura, Taguig.
The defending champions successfully retained their crown, extending their dominance in the league following an undefeated 9-0 regular-season campaign.
Boom Esports carried its impressive regular-season momentum into the playoffs, maintaining its winning form throughout the upper bracket.
The beasts opened its playoff campaign with a commanding 4-0 sweep against Titan Esports Club in the Upper Bracket Semifinals.
They continued their dominant run in the Upper Bracket Finals, taking down second-seeded TNT Tropang Alab, 4-1, to secure their place in the Grand Finals.
Facing Team JGame Esports in the championship match, Boom sealed the series to complete its title defense and secure their third PKL championship.

Daniii puts team above individual glory
Adding to Boom Esports’ successful campaign, John “Daniii” Bulanadi was named Finals Most Valuable Player (FMVP) for his impressive performance in the championship series.
When asked about winning his second PKL title and earning the Finals MVP award, Daniii expressed happiness and gratitude, emphasizing the importance of his teammates in achieving the milestone.

“Actually, there is no specific word to describe what I am feeling right now. I guess I’m happy because our team showed a really great performance. I wasn’t really thinking about the MVP award, but I’m thankful that I was able to receive it as well. And I guess I’m also thankful to my teammates because without them, I wouldn’t have been able to bring out my best performance.” Daniii shared.
With the PKL Fall 2026 concluded, Boom Esports and JGame Esports will compete in the 2026 Honor of Kings Nations Clash (KNC), scheduled from November 20 to 29 in Penang, Malaysia.

Both teams, including third place, TNT Tropang Alab will also compete in the Honor of Kings International Championship (KIC) 2026 starting December 26 in Jakarta, Indonesia. (By David Buenaventura, INQUIRER.net Intern)
